title: 约里克 · 花园小灯
description: 戴兜帽的约里克把小灯放在花园石边，长柄铲静静靠好。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Yorick is an adult hooded wanderer with a broad heavy cloak, gray-blue skin, a strong covered silhouette, and a recognizable long-handled spade. His fully opaque robe, gloves, and boots are softened into rounded shapes; a small glowing vial hangs at the collar without any grim or frightening imagery.
art_direction.scene: He kneels beside a little garden stone and places a warm lantern next to a pot of white flowers. The spade rests securely against a fence, and a tiny friendly mist-shaped companion sits apart like a quiet garden pet. Keep the composition spacious and peaceful, with visible wax-crayon strokes, warm paper margins, and every important prop clearly separated.
art_direction.palette: slate blue, warm amber, moss green, ivory, cream
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
